headline: Avocado transporters in Michoacán denounce alleged labor simulation by packing companies
summary: Cargo transport operators tied to Michoacán's avocado export chain accuse packing houses of sham employment, forced subcontracting and economic penalties. They have requested union representation from COCENA.
why: Michoacán is the main source of Mexico's avocado exports, and labor disputes along the supply chain can disrupt shipments to foreign buyers.
original_headline: Transportistas del aguacate en Michoacán denuncian presunta simulación laboral de empacadoras
